purpose: Seven-ligand Siglec-9 GNINA bridge batch with five coordinate-sourced controls and two literature-reconstructed glycomimetics
scientific_warning: The five control structures have authoritative chemical or experimental coordinate provenance. BTCNeu5Ac and MTTSNeu5Ac were reconstructed from published chemical definitions and require independent carbohydrate-chemistry review. None are Siglec-9 co-crystal poses. GNINA scores are computational prioritization evidence only.

receptor.box_definition: 30 A cube centered on the conserved R120/W128/N129 sialic-acid recognition region in AF-Q9Y336-F1 residues 18-144.

candidates.experimental_affinity_note: The cited Siglec-9 study supports binding or comparative recognition but does not provide a complete exact-Kd set for this five-member bridge batch.
